app.about.title: Free OBD-II scanner in your browser
app.about.intro: WOBD reads your car's check engine light codes and live data through a USB OBD-II adapter and explains them in plain English: how urgent each code is, what usually causes it, and what to tell your mechanic. There's nothing to install and it's free. Not sure what a code means? Try Code Search or the how-to guide.
app.about.needsTitle: What do I need to use WOBD?
app.about.needsAnswer: A car with OBD-II (US model year 1996 or newer), a USB ELM327-compatible adapter, and a laptop or Chromebook running Chrome, Edge, or Opera.
app.about.phoneTitle: Does WOBD work on a phone?
app.about.phoneAnswer: No. WOBD uses Web Serial, which phones and tablets don't support. Use a laptop or Chromebook.
app.about.privacyAnswer: Yes. Scan data stays in your browser. Only a search you choose to open, or a VIN lookup you agree to, leaves the site.
app.about.offlineTitle: Can I look up a code without an adapter?
app.about.offlineAnswer: Yes. Code Search explains trouble codes offline, with no adapter or car needed.
app.about.whatAnswer: WOBD is a free OBD-II scanner that runs in your browser. It gives general information, not a professional diagnosis, so always confirm a problem before replacing parts.
app.about.footerPrivacy: Free and open source. Your scan data never leaves this computer.
